title: UI Resource
description: One curated UI component (or legacy library/tweet). Approved in data/resources/; unreviewed harvest in data/inbox/ with status pending_review. Entity is a component tile; source is filter/badge only. vibe and scene are browse axes; stack and license are filters.

id.description: Stable slug. Must match the JSON filename.

source_url.description: Canonical page for this resource. For a tweet, the post URL.

vibe.description: 气质. Primary browse axis. Open slugs, at least one.

scene.description: 场景. Primary browse axis. Open slugs, at least one.

stack.description: Tech filter tags. Open slugs. May be empty.

license.description: Access model for the catalog: free, pro, or mixed. This is not an SPDX identifier.

preview.description: Live source preview and optional offline screenshot. Prefer embed_url as the primary display source (origin site’s component preview). screenshot is optional fallback only. At least one of screenshot or embed_url is required. See docs/preview-policy.md.

screenshot.description: Optional offline fallback image under public/. Harvest may store /previews/<file>. On GitHub Pages the UI must resolve this with import.meta.env.BASE_URL (absolute /previews/… ignores Vite base and 404s).

embed_url.description: Primary live preview URL from the origin site when available (e.g. 21st cdn.21st.dev …/bundle.<ts>.html?theme=light). Otherwise the component/docs page URL. UI should prefer this over screenshot.

usage.description: Copy-pasteable usage snippet. Markdown with fenced code is fine.

x_meta.description: Present only when kind is tweet.

source.description: Origin library site. Used as browse filter and badge, not as the card title.
